lifecycle.status: Champion retained; waiting for settled forecast losses before opening a review.

policy.description: After a settled forecast loss, lock a challenger before collecting a new confirmation sample. Promote only for lower log loss, non-worse Brier and accuracy, and a paired weekly bootstrap showing improvement. No changes after a single upset.

benchmark.budget: 5 fixed candidates, 3 expanding date-block folds; no random split, no tuning on final 20% of dates; single CPU.

test.interval_note: 200 calendar-week block bootstrap samples of fixed final-test predictions; approximate performance uncertainty, not a game probability interval.

benchmark.outcome_rules: Conditional on a decisive eventual winner, including overtime. Draws and no contests excluded; this is NOT an unconditional win probability or a sportsbook settlement forecast.
benchmark.calibration: No post-hoc calibration; reliability measured on held-out data.
limitations: Result-only baseline; no confirmed injuries, starters, travel, weather or lineups.
Score margin is not possession-adjusted efficiency.
Pre-event feature timestamps are uploader assertions, not independently verified.
Historical performance does not establish present-day calibration.

lifecycle.status: Champion retained; waiting for settled forecast losses before opening a review.

policy.description: After a settled forecast loss, lock a challenger before collecting a new confirmation sample. Promote only for lower log loss, non-worse Brier and accuracy, and a paired weekly bootstrap showing improvement. No changes after a single upset.

test.interval_note: 200 calendar-week block bootstrap samples of fixed final-test predictions; approximate performance uncertainty, not a game probability interval.
